MID 0050 条码目标。请在采集流程的设备指令节点配置条码来源、唯一请求 I: MID 0050 barcode target. Configure its barcode source, unique request ID and expected OK count in a Device command node. The barcode requires 1–25 printable ASCII characters; oversized values are rejected, never truncated. Execution continues after a matching MID 0052 acknowledgement. Vin is a read-only result field.
